articleTitle: Lithium Battery SOC Estimation Based on Extended Kalman Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Battery power detection has always been the core of the battery management system of electric vehicles, and the fast and accurate estimation of charged state can guarantee the safe operation of electric vehicles. This article is based on the electric car with iron phosphate lithium-ion battery PNGV model to complete the estimate of the lithium ion battery SOC, using Matlab Simulink module and simulation of the model. And it proves that PNGV model had higher precision. This system uses the extended kalman filter algorithm to estimate the charge state (SOC) of lithium battery and give the concrete implementation steps. Experimental simulation show that using the extended kalman filtering algorithm can rapidly estimate the charged state of lithium-ion batteries, the maximum error is about 4%, the average error is around 2%, can satisfy the accuracy of the battery management system needs.

articleTitle: Study on Fatigue Driving Detection Model Based on Steering Operation Features and Eye Movement Features
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Fatigue driving is one of the invisible killers on the expressway, which can lead to serious traffic accidents. Therefore, the development of real-time driver fatigue detection and warning devices can effectively reduce the possibility of road accidents caused by fatigue driving. Based on the theoretical research of fatigue driving and information fusion, fatigue driving experiment was carried out using driving stimulation platform and eye tracker to record steering operation data and eye movement data of 10 drivers. Total of 25 fatigue indicators were extracted, 23 of which were selected with valid statistical significance. 9-dimensional optimal subset was filtered out from these 23 indicators by sequential floating forward selection method and support vector machine classification. Finally, real-time fatigue detection model was built based on sliding time window principle with an accuracy of 91%, sensitivity of 94% and specificity of 88%.

articleTitle: A Survey on Wireless Power Transfer based Charging Scheduling Schemes in Wireless Rechargeable Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Recently, the wireless sensor networks (WSNs) technology has increasingly become a promising tool for information collection, transmission and processing. Nevertheless, due to the features of sensor nodes such as small size and limited battery capacity, the energy problem has emerged as a foremost bottleneck in WSNs. Fortunately, with the rapid development of wireless power transfer (WPT) technologies and intelligent mobile nodes, the bottleneck can be tackled thoroughly by the battery charging schemes. In this paper, we survey the WPT based wireless rechargeable sensor networks (WRSNs), which utilize the mobile wireless charging vehicles (WCVs) to periodically charge the sensor nodes in WSNs. In WRSNs, the major challenge is minimizing charging costs in order to guarantee a promised lifetime of sensor nodes, which requires an effective analysis of charging factors such as the number, traveling speed, charging range, charging power, traveling path and charging period of WCVs. Hence, we review the latest charging scheduling schemes in WRSNs via classifying and comparing them from five different aspects. Then, we summarize the design pattern of charging scheduling.

articleTitle: Real-Time Rollover Warning in Tripped and Un-tripped Rollovers with A Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Nearly 35% of passenger vehicle accident deaths are from rollover crashes. In vehicle stability control system, the active rollover prevention is presented to prevent rollovers. An imminent rollover should be detected immediately through accurate and reliable detection for active vehicle rollover prevention. A traditional rollover index is able to detect un-tripped rollovers. However, it fails to detect tripped rollovers from external inputs such as tripping by the force of a vehicle striking a curb or a road bump. Thus, a new neural network algorithm to detect both tripped and un-tripped rollovers is needed so any estimation algorithms to determine unknown parameters will no longer be used. The neural network algorithm uses multi-variables from available sensors on the vehicle to calculate and categorize the rollover warning into 3 levels: “Safe”, “Low Risk”, and “High Risk”. Moreover, the algorithm can detect both tripped and un-tripped rollover by testing with a 1/5th scaled vehicle. In order to show dynamic similarity between the 1/5th scale vehicle and a full-sized vehicle, the Buckingham π theorem is used. From experiment results, it is clear that the neural network algorithm can be used to accurately enable the rollover warning for the tripped and un-tripped rollover.

articleTitle: Linear Feedback and LQR Controller Design for Aircraft Pitch Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, the pitch control system of aircraft is designed using Linear Feedback and Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) approach. The model we used in this research work is F-16 aircraft model. As the controllers we used can be applied to the linear system, so we used linearized aircraft model. Pole placement technique is used to find the value of feedback gain K for Linear Feedback Controller. The value of feedback gain matrix K in LQR control technique is calculated by choosing suitable values of Q and R matrices, where Q and R are weighing matrix. Block diagrams, MATLAB simulation diagrams, and Simulation results are presented. Finally, according to the initialization of state space vector, the response of pitch control system is analyzed and compared the performance of both controllers.

articleTitle: Sensorless Vector Control of Three-Phase Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Model Reference Adaptive System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The speed sensorless vector control system not only saves the speed sensor but also reduces the size of the system device. It reduces the cost and improve the system's operating accuracy and reliability, which has strong practical value and economic benefits. Now many scholars have engaged in research in this area and achieved some results in simulation research, laying a solid foundation for practical applications basis. The model reference adaptive system(MRAS) was developed from the late 1950s which belongs to a type of adaptive system. From the structure, MRAS can be divided into three parts: adjustable model, reference model and adaptive law. The idea of MRAS identification is to use an expression that does not contain unknown parameters as the expected model, and an expression that contains the parameters to be identified is used in the adjustable model. And the two models have the same physical significance of output. Using two models of the difference in the output amount is achieved through the appropriate adaptive law to identify the parameters of the PMSM (Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor). This paper designs a three-phase PMSM sensorless vector control system based on MRAS. The simulation model and results are given and analyzed.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-Based Maintenance Scheduling for Resource Constrained Flow Line System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of condition-based maintenance for a two-machine flow line which consists of an upstream production machine, a downstream production machine and an immediate buffer with maintenance resource constraints. Due to the constrained maintenance resource, the maintenance actions are imperfect, and they are purposefully initiated when the machines are operating on a deteriorated quality states represented by multiple decreasing yield levels. A continuous-time semi-Markov decision processes model is formulated to describe the machine degradation processes. The distributed model-free average reward reinforcement learning algorithm, semi-Markov average reward technique algorithm is used to implement within each machine and its adjacent buffer and determine the optimal maintenance policy of the total system. The numerical results show that the approach can converge to the approximate optimal solution. Also, the effects of the variation of some parameters on the optimal policy and on the average cost rate are given.

articleTitle: Active Battery Balancing Circuit Based on Optimized Flyback Convertor for Large Lithium-ion Battery Packs
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper presents an active battery balancing circuit based on optimized flyback converter.Through modularization and hierarchical distributed design,the battery balacncing circuit can be easily expanded for large-scale battery packs. There are two improvements in the balancing circuit based on the flyback convertor. The first advantage of the balancing circuit increase the RCD clamp circuit, reducing the energy consumption,preventing the MOS transistor switch from being reversed by the flyback voltage. The second optimization apply for a predictive gate drive technology which replaces the flyback converter rectifier diode with a MOS transistor. It not only improves the efficiency of the battery balancing circuit,but also increases the adaptive dead-time, improving the system Stability. Finally, an experiment using 6 Lithium-ion batteries proves the feasibility of the balanced scheme proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of a Brain Controlled Wheelchair
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The brain machine interface has a profound impact on paralysis or the life of the elderly. They can control all kinds of equipment without the need of both hands. The electric wheelchair has become very popular. This article introduces us to control the wheelchair by replacing traditional arms with EEG signals. We control the rotation of the wheelchair by the times of intentional blinking. The concentration of the signal in the EEG is taken as the signal to control the wheelchair, and the signal is transmitted to the STM32 to realize the forward control of the wheelchair. We have done a lot of tests to keep the error rate of the system at a lower level and the reliability of the system is high. In the future we will do adaptive threshold setting.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Control Design of Quadrotor UAV Based on CPSO
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: For the Quadrotor UAV PID controller parameter tuning, it is difficult to get the Optimum by traditional methods. In this paper, the chaos particle swarm optimization algorithm is introduced into the optimization process of the quadrotor UAV controller parameters, In addition, a fault handling mechanism is added to the controller, it can effectively fault-tolerant and ensure safety flight when When the drone actuator fails, Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by simulation on the matlab experimental platform. The results show that the proposed method can significantly improve the flight performance of quadrotor UAVs and their ability to handle faults.

articleTitle: Design of Control System of Pneumatic Regulating Valves Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Pneumatic regulating valves are the most common actuators in industrial production and play a decisive role in the control of the flow of media in industrial process. In response to the demand of modern industry for intelligent control algorithm in control valve, a control system of pneumatic regulating valves based on STM32F4 chip is designed. The system is designed for the nonlinear problem of pneumatic control valve, and the corresponding genetic fuzzy PID control algorithm is designed. Simulation results show that the algorithm can improve the control performance and design a feasible hardware circuit platform. The system proves this Advantages of intelligent control algorithms for system design.

articleTitle: Improved Interacting Multiple Model-New Nearest Neighbor Data Association Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: For the multi-maneuvering target fast tracking problem, an interactive multiple model-nearest neighbor data association algorithm (IMM-NNDA) was improved, and an improved interactive multiple model-new nearest neighbor data association algorithm (IIMM-NNNDA) was proposed. Using a type of radar check data as a processing object, the processing results of the IMM-NNDA algorithm and the IIMM-NNNDA algorithm are compared. The computation speed of the IIMM-NNNDA algorithm is improved by 17.6%, and the correlation accuracy rate is increased by 14.8%. The results show that the IIMM-NNNDA algorithm can more accurately distinguish the multi-target trajectory and achieve a better tracking effect. On the other hand, the IIMM-NNNDA algorithm still shows good tracking performance for the special phenomenon of target data loss in a short time.

articleTitle: Adaptive Fast Sliding Model Attitude Tracking Control for Flexible Spacecraft
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, we studies the adaptive fast sliding attitude tracking control problem for flexible spacecraft without any information about time-varying external disturbances and flexible vibration. Firstly, two adaptive update laws are designed to estimation the upper bounds of the disturbance and the vibration parameter. Secondly, in order to guarantee the fast convergence speed, we designed a double power control term. Based on the adaptive update laws and double power control term, we proposed an adaptive fast sliding model attitude tracking control law for the flexible spacecraft with time-varying reference trajectory. The proposed controller can fast stabilize the attitude and angular velocity tracking error system. Finally, the numerical simulation illustrates the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Adaptive Modeling of Brushless DC Motor Drive System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The superiority of control performance depends on the accuracy of the mathematical model of the system. However, it is difficult to establish precise mathematical models for control systems in industrial electromechanical systems. Establishing a high-precision brushless DC motor drive system model can improve the performance of the motion control system. This paper employs the method of Kalman filter to estimate states that rectifies original sparse sampled states and the method of online recursive least square to discern the unknown parameters of a forth order dynamical system with respect to the brushless DC motor driven systems. The model can be derived adaptively for the dynamical systems in real time. Experimental results show that the derived model agrees well with the actual output of the dynamical system. So, the proposed method provides a promising approach to the class of brushless DC motor driven systems with sparse feedback samples.

articleTitle: Control, Modeling and Simulation on A Novel Regenerative Brake System of Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Regenerative braking is a vital technology to reduce the electricity consumption in a variety of electric vehicles. A considerable improvement on energy economy is achieved by the electric motor running as a generator during vehicle deceleration. As an essential part of the regenerative braking system (RBS), regenerative hydraulic braking system (RHBS) acts an important role in regenerative braking. In this paper, a novel RHBS system with a cooperative control strategy is proposed to meet the requirement of both energy recovery and dynamic braking performance. The cooperative control strategy is composed of a hierarchical control structure in RBS and RHBS. The regenerative braking system is modeled and simulated in MATLAB/Simulink and AMESim platform. A specified ECE (Economic Commission for Europe) driving cycle is utilized as the simulation scenario. Simulation results show that the proposed RHBS has an expected hydraulic pressure control proficiency and the RBS with cooperative control strategy is effective in improving energy economy and dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of ATP Compound Axis Control System for Intersatellite Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: ATP compound axis control system is an important component and key technology in the intersatellite optical communication system, which can effectively improve the tracking accuracy and system bandwidth of the photoelectric tracking system. In this paper, the principle and structure of the compound axis control system are introduced in detail, the bandwidth and error suppression ability of the system are analyzed. The simulation experiment of ATP compound axis control system is carried out by Matlab/Simulink, and the tracking precision of the system is less than 2μrad. The experimental results show that the ATP compound axis control system has the advantages of good dynamic performance, high tracking accuracy and strong error suppression ability.

articleTitle: An Active Balance Circuit Applied to Lithium Ion Battery Packs
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: An active balance circuit based on the topology of flyback transformer is proposed in the article for the balance management of high capacity Lithium-ion battery packs in space. The circuit can control the value of the balance current by fixed duty cycle control, to achieve balance function for Lithium-ion battery packs. Compared to passive equilibrium circuit, the active balance circuit can effectively improve the balance speed of the high-capacity battery packs, meeting the requirement of balance speed and reducing the energy loss of the battery packs, increasing the service life of the battery packs. The balance circuit can realize modular and control simple. The hardware circuit was built for the project. The experiment results prove the correctness and effectiveness of the scheme.

articleTitle: Observer-Based Consensus Control of Multi-Agent Systems with Input Delay
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, the leader-follower consensus problem of multi-agent systems with input delay is discussed with observer-based protocol. Firstly, a distributed state observer is introduced to estimate the state of each agent by using the relative output information between neighbors. Secondly, based on the truncated prediction approach, the consensus algorithm is proposed by utilizing the estimated state information. The sufficient conditions are constructed by Lyapunov stability theory and then solved by a set of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs) with iterative parameters. Finally, a simulation example is given to verity the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: State Feedback Control and Applied to PV Systems Under Improved MPPT Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, a state feedback closed-loop system with integral control is proposed for photovoltaic system output voltage regulation. Where P&O algorithm is used to control the voltage output. In order to verify the control scheme, it was applied to DC - DC converter boost type to improve its dynamic performance, and apply the improved system to the maximum power point. The proposed method is tested by computing simulation in Matlab/SIMULINK environment. The results show that the control technology can be applied to DC/DC converters and adjust the output voltage, then the validity of the technology is confirmed.

articleTitle: Time Series Clustering and Evaluation of Unknown Working Conditions of Mismatched Photovoltaic Array Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: It is not clear whether unknown working conditions of a solar power system yield distinct clusters of currents and voltages where each cluster has definite physical implication. The problem is associated with smartness of next generation of condition monitoring, prognosis and fault diagnosis in the field of photovoltaic power systems. Raw time data of currents and voltages are divided into many subsequences to measuring similarity through DTW, then cluster similarity through the k-means method. All clusters are evaluated by a purity value approach. It is shown that all derived clusters agree well with certain group or groups of unknown working conditions.

articleTitle: Adaptive Car-Following Control of Intelligent Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This article proposes an adaptive fuzzy sliding mode control method for longitudinal motion of intelligent electric vehicles (IEVs) with nonlinear and strong time-varying characteristics under uncertainty interference. A dynamic system model is established to characterize the mechanism of IEVs longitudinal behavior. An adaptive hierarchical control architecture is constructed in which the upper control layer is for obtaining sliding mode control law of the desired acceleration based on the inter-vehicle state information. A fuzzy system is utilized to optimize the sliding mode control to realize adaptive control, which can effectively overcome the parameter uncertainty characteristics of IEVs. In the lower control layer, a switch logic with hysteresis boundary is developed to ensure ride comfort, and the expected torque is calculated in real time based on the inverse dynamic model to track the desired acceleration planned by the upper control layer. Simulations results show that the proposed adaptive control method has great potential to guarantee the tracking capability and security at the same time provide a robustness to the interference of the preceding vehicle acceleration during car-following process.

articleTitle: Research on Self-Organizing Target Hunting for Mobile Robot Group
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Aiming at the formation of aggregation behavior model of swarm robots, a self-organizing motion model based on particle system mechanics and perceptual state weighting is established to realize the autonomous transfer of robot motion state. Using the selected model, the self-organizing aggregation behavior simulation experiments are conducted for two cases with boundary constraints and no boundary constraints. The maximum coverage of different groups of scale is realized, and the correctness of the trap model is verified by the target hunting test of the group robot with random position.

articleTitle: Study on Current Decoupling Method of Three-Phase Grid-Connected Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: According to the state feedback decoupling theory of modern control theory, a current decoupling method combined with pole placement is proposed for the topology of three-phase grid-connected control system based on voltage orientation. This method is simple and practical and dq axis current decoupling is realized. The simulation model of three-phase grid-connected control system is established by using Matlab/Simulink. Then the hardware experiment platform with DSP as the control core is designed. The control software is programmed in Q15 format fixed-point realization method and assembler language. The simulation and experimental results prove the validity of current decoupling method and show that control system has good dynamic and static performance.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Contribution Degree of Environmental Parameters in Wave Induced Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Wave induced magnetic field is the main field source form in the natural electromagnetic field. It is the object of study and calculation by geophysicists in various countries. Each of the environmental parameters in the wave induced magnetic field contributes differently to the amplitude of the field source. In this paper, based on the theoretical model of wave induced magnetic field and the variation of the main environmental parameters of offshore waters in China, the contribution of each environmental parameter to the amplitude of the induced magnetic field of the waves is calculated. By classifying environmental parameters, we extract its key parameters. The research results of this paper will provide support for the design of underwater magnetic field observation methods in the marine environment and its characteristics prediction. In addition, based on the theoretical model and analysis results, the range of magnetic field amplitude induced by the waves can be estimated, and the spatial variation of amplitudes in different sea areas can be effectively predicted based on the acquired environmental parameters in a number of unknown sea areas. The research results can also provide theoretical support for marine environmental monitoring, exploration of seabed mineral deposits, and electromagnetic communication of underwater vehicles.

articleTitle: A Review of Value-Focused Thinking (VFT) Application
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper is a review of the Value-Focused Thinking (VFT). With the introduction for VFT from 1992 to the present after several decades, VFT was applied in many aspects. Kneey proposed the method to create new ideas for decision-making, which brought tremendous inspiration to people. Especially, the decision-makers have improved decision-making effectiveness. With the application of VFT in the company strategy, the company brought huge economic benefits. In the selection of innovation model, previous methods were different from which is with the focus on value. US Department of Defense used VFT for the procurement of national defense weapons, significantly saving military spending. This paper mainly reviews from the following three aspects of VFT: company strategy, decision model innovation and defense acquisition. In addition, the relationship between VFT and decision-making is discussed.

articleTitle: Modeling and Robust Optimization for System of Systems Problems under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The paper proposes a novel idea for how to model and optimize uncertain problems of system of systems (SoS). Firstly, the background and necessity on researching SoS and its robust optimization under uncertainty are introduced. Secondly, preparatory models are constructed to model the aggregations and cooperation among SoS and are regarded as the main body of further studies. Subsequently, a scenario-based model to formulate uncertainties and a Markov-based model to simulate uncertainty evolutions of SoS are introduced. Then, a novel idea for how to solving robust optimization under uncertainties in single-stage and multi-stage is proposed. The methods of the researches can be applied to solve SoS problems under uncertainty in real world, such as transportation systems planning, power grid systems operation and competition considered financial cooperation etc.

articleTitle: Diagnostic Strategy Optimization Method Based on Information Entropy Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The optimal design of diagnostic strategy is an important part of test design. It is of great significance for reducing test cost, improving fault diagnosis ability, diagnostic efficiency and diagnostic accuracy. Model-based diagnostic strategy optimization design is a commonly used design method. This article is aimed at the problem that it is difficult for existing diagnostic strategy search algorithms to search for optimal solutions quickly and economically under complex conditions. The optimization design of diagnosis strategy based on information entropy for multi-valued test and test uncertainty is studied.

articleTitle: Research on Target Assignment of Multiple-UAVs Based on Improved Hybrid Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper is based on genetic algorithm to solve the target assignment problem in the course of target reconnaissance. In order to increase the efficiency and improve the local search ability of the genetic algorithm, a hybrid algorithm of genetic algorithm and hill-climbing algorithm is adopted in this paper. And population catastrophe is also used to improve the performance of hybrid algorithm. The simulation results show that the improved algorithm has faster solution speed, better optimization capability, and can solve target assignment problem effectively.

articleTitle: Decoupling Controller Design of Three-Axis Turntable Based on Auto Disturbance Rejection Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Aiming at the nonlinear coupling problem of three-axis turntable system, this paper uses auto disturbance rejection control (ADRC) technique to design a decoupling controller. First of all, this paper set up the kinematics model of the system, and chose the control algorithms of nonlinear discrete form. On this basis, the signal preprocessing design of tracking differentiator was proposed, and the relevant parameters were adjusted. Finally, the simulation and analysis was carried out. Compared with the traditional PID control, the results show that the ADRC strategy has better precision and stability performance under the influence of inaccurate modeling and unknown interference. This also proves that the designed ADRC controller can realize decoupling function and satisfy the requirement of three-axis turntable.

articleTitle: The Control Strategies for High Frequency Algorithmic Trading
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: High Frequency Algorithmic Trading has developed rapidly in recent years as the disruptive information technology such as deep learning emerges. So, do the public concerns about the security and reliability of the algorithmic trading in stock markets as well. Taking advantage of the highly fluctuated trading data, the automated methods of trading have evolved accordingly. This article first reviews the existing literature on algorithmic trading, electronic trading, and high frequency trading. The most important underlying control strategy and mechanism of high frequency algorithmic trading is named “market maker” in stock market. Accordingly, we analyze the fundamental characteristics and functions of market maker in trading and illustrate several control strategies in high frequency algorithmic trading. Our work open the door for the design of sophisticated automated control strategies for financial markets, which are fundamentally different from those for traditional physical systems such as air traffic control system.

articleTitle: Design of the Family Intelligent Wheelchair Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: We proposed an Intelligent navigation control scheme for intelligent wheelchair which is used at home. It used to control the action of wheelchair, such as start-up, straight line driving, turning and stopping. We study on laser sensors based localization of intelligent wheelchair, and using gyroscope to measure the roll angle. For straight line driving and turning, the use of three closed-loop control system to control the action of wheelchair. It ensured the accuracy of straight line driving and turning. Then closed-loop transfer function are obtained, then the mathematical model are set up. We present a modeling description of block diagram of control system through MATLAB, and we analysed the feasibility of the control system.

articleTitle: Ship Life-Saving Training System Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of life-saving equipment training and ensure the safety of trainees, this paper analyzes the functional requirements of the ship lifesaving training system and designs the overall structure of it. With two collaborative working modes designed, a method of multi-role collaborative training is proposed to achieve multiuser training which is very flexible. The system has built a virtual database of scene and taken the method of regularly acquiring and sending data to solve the problem of collaborative simulation. The three-dimensional modeling software and Unity3D engine are used to build scenes of fire, stormy waves, wrecks and men overboard etc. A series of lifesaving process are simulated. Finally, the virtual training system of free-fall lifeboat is developed. The system is stable by tested, possessing a good training effect.

articleTitle: Parametric Modeling of Envelope Spiroid Based on Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The envelope spiroid is obtained by enveloping with special method on the basis of the traditional spiroid. This paper will take its parametric modeling as the research object, and analyze it from three aspects: cone worm drive characteristics, space meshing theory and tooth surface equation. Firstly, according to the mathematical model of the cone-and-worm drive, the calculation formula of the tooth surface parameters is derived to draw the profile and spiral of the axial section of the cone. Then, combined with the theory of cone-worm drive meshing, the parametric worm gear is parametrically designed. Finally, based on the parametric design function of Pro/E, the corresponding cone-worm worm gear model is obtained through the simulation process. The method used in this paper can realize the accurate modeling of the cone-and-worm worm gear, which is the premise of the subsequent research.

articleTitle: Study on Distribution Network Line Level Evaluation Model Based on Dynamic Classification Combination
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of the current classification models of distribution lines, such as low classification accuracy and poor robustness, a rating classification model of distribution network based on dynamic classification is proposed. Based on K-PAM, the model dynamically combines the decision tree classification method C4.5 to efficiently use the prediction information of base classifier to achieve higher classification accuracy. Finally, the real data of the three distribution networks were used to conduct the experimental analysis, and the classification efficiency, classification accuracy and robustness of the three methods were compared.

articleTitle: T-S Fuzzy Maximum Power Point Tracking Control of Z-source Photovoltaic Inverter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper investigates a Takagi-Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy control algorithm for maximum power point tracking (MPPT) of photovoltaic (PV) systems. A Z-source inverter is used as an interface between the PV array and the load. To improve the system performance of MPPT under rapidly changing weather conditions, a feedback controller with the T-S fuzzy model was designed to regulate output power by controlling the duty cycle of the inverter. Corresponding simulations of the proposed system was implemented in MATLAB/Simulink. Simulation results show that the system is extremely efficient under varying atmospheric conditions and reaches optimal operating point in less time with no oscillations in steady-state.

articleTitle: Compressor Blade Fault Diagnosis Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: An improved method of image analysis is proposed aiming at the problems of high dependence on the inspectors' professionalism during the compressor blades crack detection and the fact that the crack is sometimes blurred and not easy to be noticed. The histogram of a large number of captured images are template matched based on OpenCV, and the images with crack are counted. After that, all the images with crack detected are subjected to erosion and histogram equalization. The crack is amplified by getting a local minimum value. The improved Canny operator is then used to perform edge detection on the image after erosion and histogram equalization to improve the efficiency of crack image segmentation. The USART HMI and STM32 are combined to build a visual fault diagnosis system to judge whether the compressor blade crack length exceeds the allowable value. The system will promptly alarm to remind the maintenance personnel to pay attention to change or repair the blade if the crack size is too large. The simulation results show that the proposed method has good feasibility.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment Method Based on Performance Degradation and Improved Dempster-Shafer Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In view of the difficulty of the traditional reliability evaluation method for multivariate performance parameters, this paper puts forward a kind of reliability assessment method which is based on performance degradation and Dempster-Shafer (DS) evidence theory. Firstly, the degradation data of each performance parameter is modeled, and their degradation models and life distributions are obtained. Secondly, a distance function of Jousselme is introduced to modify the traditional evidence theory to improve the processing ability of the conflicting evidence information. Thirdly, the improved DS evidence theory is used to fuse and make decisions on life data of each key performance parameter, and then the overall reliability index of the product can be obtained. Finally, this method is tested with performance degradation data of fiber-optic gyroscope and the storage life of it is 38,000 hours. The experimental result shows that this method is more reasonable and accurate for reliability assessment of multivariate performance parameters of fiber-optic gyroscope and has certain reference value for maintenance support decision of equipments. It is also applicable to the reliability assessment of other equipments.

articleTitle: Application of Hybrid Filtering Algorithm Based on Neural Network in INS/GPS Integrated Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Filtering algorithm is One of the key technologies that affect the performance and reliability of INS/GPS integrated navigation systems. The paper adopts hybrid filtering algorithm based on neural network. Using the powerful learning and identification capabilities of the neural network, the hybrid filtering algorithm solve the problem of the Kalman filtering precision degradation caused by the system noise and the measurement noise and the absence of the GPS signal. The simulation results show that the hybrid filtering algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Relationship between System Physics Limits and System Bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Any practical system will limit the performance of the system due to physical limitations. This paper uses a fast mirror system as an example to derive the specific relationship between the physical limits of the system and the performance of the system, and to clarify the changes in the physical limits to the closed-loop bandwidth of the entire system. The impact of the system's closed-loop bandwidth is linked to the physical limits of the actual physical system, providing a basis for system analysis and the selection of physical devices for similar systems. the relationship between the system's operating range and the system's closed-loop bandwidth will be discussed. Finally, the relationship between the system's range of motion and the closed-loop bandwidth of the system is analyzed.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Path Selection for Road Transportation of Dangerous Goods
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Since the transportation of dangerous goods is related to the fundamental interests of all parties, the road transportation path selection of dangerous goods must be considered in a balance between the transportation cost of enterprises and the risk in the transportation process. In this paper, the characteristics of road transportation for dangerous goods are analyzed in order to determine the index of multiobjective path selection model, which combined with the case of refined oil distribution in Beijing.

articleTitle: An Approach to Non-normal Process Capability Analysis Using Johnson Transformation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The process capability analysis requires that the quality characteristics data follow normal distribution. In actual production, many stable processes do not necessarily satisfy the assumption of normal distribution. Many scholars and quality engineers have proposed methods to transform non-normal data into normal data so that these data can be analyzed using the process capability indices, resulting in reasonable and effective conclusions. One approach to solve this problem is to use the Johnson distribution system to convert these non-normal data. This paper proposes a systematic method to deal with non-normal data and calculate its process capability indices. The method is combined with the percentage fitting of Johnson distribution system, and the steps are given in detail. Finally, this method is applied to a practical case study and the process capability indices can be calculate. The effectiveness and practicability of the method are verified by simulation experiments. In this paper, Minitab analysis software is used to assist with strong operability and convenience, and can be used to guide production practices.

articleTitle: Dynamic Model of Bank Queuing System and Its Optimal Management
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, we develop a stochastic dynamic model for the queuing system in a commercial bank. We define an objective functional based on the expressions of servers wage and customers waiting time. By following this, an optimization problem is formulated and solved. Furthermore, we introduce a tentative method of choosing the optimum number of open service windows by classifying the servers into two categories: primary servers and experienced servers. It is anticipated to reduce the bank's expense as well as customers waiting time and promote their satisfaction if the technique presented here is implemented. The dynamic system is simulated with numerical experiments and the corresponding optimization problems are solved giving the optimal number of service windows required to open. Since the proposed dynamic model can be generally applied to any commercial banks, it is strongly believed that the procedure developed in this paper is of great benefit for both the bank and the customers served.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control for Spatial Turntable with Compensation of Cable-Harness Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: An adaptive control scheme is proposed to compensate the effects caused by cable-harness disturbance in spatial turntable. The proposed control tactics applied feedforward compensation method which is based on a PD structure and estimated value of the disturbance. Firstly, the estimation is given by a radial basis function(RBF) neural network with adaptive algorithm. Then, a control scheme is designed and the stability of system has been proved by Lyapunov theory. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate that the proposed control scheme effectively eliminated cable-harness disturbance.

articleTitle: Design of Ultra-High g Penetration Fuze Data Record Device
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: To collect the overload value of the fuze in the process of penetrating into the steel plate, the design of a data record device was carried out, in which the C8051F506 microcontroller was applied as the control core. The design of hard circuit and software program were conducted to realize the data record function, and buffer protection system with polytef as the filling material and polytetrafluoroethylene and silicone rubber as the buffer spacer was designed to protect the inner circuit. The 80mm rocket was used as a carrier to carry out the penetration test for the device. The results proved that the data recovery could well work and record data during the whole process.

articleTitle: Research on the Detection Method of Landing Sign for Unmanned Helicopter Based on Vision
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: For the detection problem of landing sign in the process of unmanned helicopter landing on ship, a kind of landing sign was designed according to the ship environment firstly, and then the corresponding processing were carried out for the designed sign, including segmentation based on color, image sampling and quantization, noise filtering, and the contour extraction, etc. For the special environment of naval ships, a variety of image processing method was used to comparative analysis, a landing sign detection method was proposed on the basis of a large number of experiments, the target image with good effect was obtained finally, which show that the method have important practical significance and engineering practical value.

articleTitle: Current Sampling Design of Six-Axis Robot Servo System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Multi-axis and modularization have become the development trend of robot servo systems. Current sampling module is an important module in the robot servo system. Its real-time capability and synchronization directly affect the dynamic performance of the system. A current sampling scheme for a six-axis robot servo system consisting of Hall current sensors, a dual-AD sampling chip AD7266 and an FPGA was proposed, which significantly reduced the sampling time while ensuring simultaneous sampling of two-phase currents by the motor. Finally, the feasibility of the scheme was tested by testing the current-loop performance of the system.

articleTitle: Delay Estimation of Dynamic System Based on Correlation Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In view of the situation that dynamic system's time-delay estimation methods are complicated and most of them need to know the system structure at first, a system time-delay estimation method based on the correlation coefficient is proposed in this paper. The implementation principle of this method is introduced in detail. The approach regards the system as a black box and does not need to know the system's structure. Through calculating the correlation coefficient of the input and output of the system, according to the variation law of the correlation coefficient, the time-delay of the system can be estimated. Simulation results show that this method has better recognition performance for low-order systems but it can easily be affected by the inertia parameter of high-order systems which maybe lead to some deviations in the results. Also, it is robust and accurate to system that contain oscillation.

articleTitle: A Target Detection System for Mobile Robot Based On Single Shot Multibox Detector Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Recent years, neural networks are used widely in the field of image processing. Neural networks have made great achievements in image classification, target detection, and semantic segmentation since 2012. In this paper, a target detection system for mobile robot is proposed based on the Single Shot Multibox Detector (SSD) neural network. The SSD neural network is trained to learn the features of input images using labeled dataset. The network model will converge using gradient descent algorithm during training. Then, the network becomes robust enough and is able to locate targets in images. In our research, we find that the performance of network is so perfect that it can hardly be done using traditional image processing algorithms. Especially, SSD network is most suitable for our system. The SSD network shows great adaptability, with 76.2% mAP (mean average precision) in the test dataset during our experiments. Detection algorithm based on SSD network has a great performance during experiments.

articleTitle: Stochastic Dynamic Model of City Bus Routes and Their Optimum Management
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, we develop a stochastic dynamic model for the city bus route subject to practical constraints. We define an objective functional based on the expressions for fuel cost, operating cost, customers waiting time, and revenue of the bus company. Following this, an optimization problem is formulated and solved using calculus of variations. It is expected to improve the bus company's revenue, reduce customers waiting time and promote their satisfaction if the solution presented here is implemented. The system is simulated with a series of numerical experiments and the corresponding optimization problems are solved giving the optimal number of buses allocated to a bus route. Since the dynamic model can be generally applied to any bus route, it is strongly believed that the procedure developed in this paper has a great potential of benefits for both the city bus company and the customers served.

articleTitle: Rolling Angle Estimation Method for GNSS/SINS Integrated Navigation System Based on Least Square Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Rotating missiles using the GNSS/SINS integrated navigation system are overloaded during launch and require powering up after launch. Therefore, it is necessary to achieve inflight alignment under high dynamic conditions. With this background, as the key technology of inflight alignment, the measurement method of roll angle has been paid more and more attention by researchers. In this paper, the roll angle estimation method of GNSS/SINS integrated navigation system based on least square method is studied. First, the principle and calculation process of this method are deduced in detail. Then it was simulated and analyzed according to the ballistic characteristics. Finally, a semi-physical simulation was performed using a turntable. The results show that this method is simple, high accuracy, good in real-time ability and has a high application value.

articleTitle: Task Interleaving Scheduling for Phased Array Radar in Multi-Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: A novel task interleaving algorithm is proposed for the resource allocation in the phased array radar. The algorithm divides the task interleaving scheduling into the time feasibility check and the energy feasibility check, and adaptively interleaves different types of tasks. Thereby wait durations in radar tasks can be fully utilized, and different workload situations can be well matched. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the successful scheduling ratio, time utilization ratio and high value ratio efficiently compared with two conventional algorithms.

articleTitle: Route Planning Algorithm of Region Important Target Search Based on PSO
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Regional Important target search problem is the typical combat mission of air combat field. To solve the problem of multi-aircraft collaborative path planning, the search probability graph is defined to encourage direct flight and reduce fuel consumption. Aims at saving time, encourage straight flight and reduce fuel consumption to set up the model of the path planning problem of the single-aircraft and multi-aircraft for the predetermined regional search. Based on the particle swarm algorithm, the problem is solved by the mutation operator of genetic algorithm, which obtained more authoritative optimal path in a larger space. Simulation results shown that the algorithm is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: A Second-Order Algorithm for the Distance Of A Point to An Epigraph
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: We proposed a second-order algorithm for the distance of a point to an epigraph in our paper. We transformed the distance into a finite generalized minimax problem and came up with the optimality conditions. A converges Q-superlinearly algorithm had been presented by using optimality functions which is based on second-order approximations of the cost function and corresponding search direction functions. Finally, to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, the nonsmooth Lyapunov function was utilized to generate nonlinear control system. Simulation results indicate that the rate of convergence is super-linear.

articleTitle: The Research on the Complexity of the Equipment Support Network Based on Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: A new method for equipment support network was introduced within the framework of complex networks theory, and in that case, the topological structure and formation characteristics of the real support network would be better understood. Especially, several typical statistical properties of the network which was from three different levels, i. e., unit level, module level and network level were analyzed. The empirical results show that equipment support network has the similar topological attributes, such as scale free behavior, small world effect, community structure and degree correlation comparing with other previously studied social or technical networks.

articleTitle: Experimental Research on the Brush-Target Method and Calorimetry Method for Measurement of High-Intensity Focused Ultrasound Power
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Aiming at solving the problem of easy damage to the conventional radiation balance method in high-intensity focusing field, a technique based on pulsed measurements was adopted which use the “brush” as absorbing target. The transducer was radiated by a definite duty factor, and the ultrasonic power can be obtained by measure the change of the target weight through the balance. The error of ultrasonic power is less than 7.8% by comparing with the calorimetric method of buoyancy change, which verifies the effectiveness of the brush-target method in measuring the HIFU power.

articleTitle: Maintenance and Appraisal Expert System Design and Knowledge Library Construction for Electronic Recycled Equipment of Certain Missile
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The electronic equipment recycling can effectively save the equipment guarantee cost and meanwhile improve the service efficiency of the equipment. The key point for electronic equipment recycling is the repairability and the repair cost of the equipment. Firstly, the paper aimed to analyze the fault characteristics and the basic maintenance and appraisal principle of the electronic recycled equipment of the guided missile; then, the paper aimed to determine the fault diagnosis method and establish the maintenance and appraisal model for the electronic recycled equipment of the guided missile; finally, the paper aimed to provide the method for constructing the expert system knowledge library, thus providing relevant reference for the electronic recycled equipment of other weapons.

Author Keywords: appraisal principle of the electronic recycled equipment
method for constructing the expert system knowledge library

articleTitle: Fault Detection for Stochastic Switched System Based on Fuzzy Adaptive Unscented Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of state estimation and fault detection for a class of stochastic switched nonlinear system with unknown characteristics of observation noise change, a system state estimation algorithm based on interactive multiple model and unscented Kalman filter (IMM-UKF) is proposed. The algorithm uses the UKF to estimate the state of each subsystem at different time points, then fuses the state estimation results of different subsystems to obtain the final state estimation, and realizes the estimation of the real state of the system. In order to achieve real-time tracking of system observation noise, a fuzzy controller is established to adjust the observation noise of IMM- UKF in real time, and a fuzzy adaptive IMM-UKF algorithm (FAIMM-UKF) is proposed. For actuator failure in a class of stochastic switched nonlinear systems, FAIMM-UKF is used to estimate the system state. Based on the result of the state estimation, residual and residual evaluation functions are established to detect the actuator fault. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation experiment.

articleTitle: A Evaluation Model of Speed Target Value Scheme for High-Speed Railway Based on Hybrid Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In order to solve the technical problem of speed target value scheme comparison of high-speed railway, a comprehensive evaluation model based on hybrid multiple attribute decision-making is proposed. Firstly, a comprehensive evaluation index system, which includes five types of first-level indexes, such as adaptability, technical standards, operational effectiveness and so on, and their corresponding second-level indexes, is established. Then, the method of improved analytic hierarchy process-G1 is used to calculate the index weight. Through using the triangular fuzzy numbers to quantify the qualitative indexes and the principle of TOPSIS, the comprehensive superior degree of various railway station schemes is calculated to determine the best one. Finally, an example of the high-speed railway from Chengdu to Chongqing is used to illustrate its operation procedure. The results show that it basically solved the problem of qualitative and quantitative comprehensive evaluation, which proves that the comprehensive evaluation model has reference value when the high-speed railway speed target value scheme is chosen, and can provide a new way of thinking and means for the decision maker.

articleTitle: Longitudinal Velocity Control of Robotic Vehicle with Articulated Suspension
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Evolution of virtual prototype technology has a paramount importance in advance mechanical system development and exploration. In this paper skid steered RVAS (Robotic Vehicle with Articulated Suspension) virtual prototype model was designed and co-simulation method was presented to integrate dynamic system model with a designed velocity tracking controller. The vehicle modelling was carried out in ADAMS/View. In addition, PID (Proportional Integral and Derivative) control strategy was employed to achieve desired velocity response along with efficient PID tuning technique in MATLAB/SIMULINK. It was observed that cosimulation was performed successfully and desired longitudinal velocity was achieved by the controller in an effective way.

articleTitle: The Release Characteristics and Selection Model for Vehicle Lane Changing of the Quadruple Left-Turn Traffic Flow at Signalized Intersection
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The release process of left-turn traffic becomes one of the key factors to affect capacity and safety of intersections. The lane changing behaviors happen when the left-turn vehicles pass through the intersection, which result the lateral interference that impacts traffic efficiency. This paper studies on the release characteristics of quadruple left-turn traffic after entering the intersection from three properties: the lane utilization ratio, the lane utilization ratio of large vehicles and the space-time trajectory. Support Vector Machine(SVM) model captured these properties is used to further analyze the selections of lane-changing behaviors of left-turn vehicles. The model is based on the release characteristics of the quadruple left-turn traffic flow and the optimal variable combination. Moreover, considering absence of data collected by loop detectors, the sensitivity analysis is performed with probabilistic principal component analysis to reveal the effect of different kernel functions. It indicates that the model with polynomial kernel function is a more effective method to predict lane-changing behaviors considering the incomplete data.

articleTitle: The Sensors' Spatial-Temporal Allocation by Linear Programming in Multi-Fighter Cooperative Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper focuses on spatial-temporal allocation of the sensors in multi-fighter cooperative detection. Airborne sensor must be coordinated efficiently to detect battlefield situation for finishing the operation which is regarded as main facilities to get scene information. According to the relationship between detection information and sensor performance, an allocation method by linear programming is proposed for improving the sensors' ability entirely. Firstly the parameters of sensor detection performance is changed into a linear value for operation, then gain the information measurement matrix among sensors and targets or detection cell, finally transform the optimization problem into a linear programming to solve. The base of spatial-temporal allocation is the relationship that sensors' different ability from the object in the combat field, so the allocation result must be update terminal by the change of operation platform. In this way, a whole sensor system with a high performance consists of individual sensors.

articleTitle: Mixed Differential Evolution Algorithm for the Multi-Objective 0–1 Programming Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Obtaining more non-dominated solution is very important for the multi-objective problem. This paper developed a new hybrid differential evolution algorithm for solving the multi-objective 0-1 programming problem, which is based on using the good point set method to generate the initial population, the traction method to deal with the constraint conditions, the analytic hierarchy process to design the weights between the objective functions. The proposed algorithm is not only improves the diversity of the population, but also overcomes the difficulty of choosing the penalty factor by the penalty function method. A number of typical multi-objective 0-1 programming problems are tested, and the test results are compared with other algorithms. The results show that the proposed algorithm can find more non-dominated solution for multi-objective 0-1 programming problems. It is an effective method to solve the multi-objective 0-1 programming problem.

articleTitle: Research on Integrity Level of Safety Instrumented System Based on BN-LOPA
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In order to reduce the occurrence of accidents in the chemical production process, the defects existing in the existing safety instrument system are compensated and the safety integrity level method is determined. This article proposes a Bayesian and protective layer analysis (BN-LOPA) method. This paper transforms the system fault tree into Bayesian network, makes up for the limitations of the fault tree, can solve multi-state variables, components are not independent, and express more complex relationships. At the same time, according to the joint probability distribution, GeNIe software is used to calculate the failure probability, and the probability of the top event can be easily and accurately calculated. The SIL is then determined based on the highest event probability and protective layer analysis. Finally, the posterior probability of basic events is calculated based on Bayesian bidirectional reasoning. The prior probability combined with the posterior probability can reduce the subjectivity, quickly and accurately identify the weak links of the system, and protect the safety of the chemical production process. The example application shows that the constructed BN-LOPA analysis model can be well integrated with the safety instrumented system to facilitate the calculation of the safety integrity level.

articleTitle: Command Governor Based Adaptive Control for Constrained Linear Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper presents a novel control method for constrained linear systems with model uncertainties. The proposed method achieves a near performance to the reference system, adaptability to the model uncertainties and meet all the state-constraints at the same time. The design of such a method involves a command governor and a model reference adaptive controller. The command governor adjusts the command signal based on the information of the nominal system to make the nominal system behaviors meet all the constraints. The adaptive controller compensates the model uncertainties of the actual plant, which makes the system to mimic the nominal closed-loop system. As a consequence, the real system can realize a quite near performance of the nominal system with stability and robustness, without violating any constraints.

articleTitle: Dual-Mode Motor Control Scheme for Electric Motorcycle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to design a dual-mode motor control scheme for electric motorcycle that can automatically switch the motor control scheme to sensorless field-oriented control when the Hall element is detected a fault by a real-time self-test program. In addition, the main content of this essay is described that how to use the sliding mode state observer to estimate the rotor position of the motor, how to start the sensorless control mode at zero motor speed and how to switch the control mode in a reasonable condition by self-checking the Hall element. At the same time, the hardware scheme and software algorithm are designed. The experimental results show that the designed electric motorcycle motor control system is reasonable and feasible, and has high practicality.

articleTitle: The Relationship between INS Aided GNSS Vector Tracking Performance and IMU Error
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Vector tracking technology can improve the tracking performance of satellite signals, ultra-tight integrated navigation technology can effectively solve the problem of tracking loop unlocking under high dynamic conditions and improve the anti-jamming performance of the tracking loop. The ultra-tight integrated navigation system based on vector tracking Combining the advantages of the above two, the data within the system is more closely related, but which means that the error of a certain subsystem will directly affect the navigation accuracy of the entire navigation system. The accuracy of the IMU directly affects the accuracy of inertial navigation. This article will study the relationship between the inertial navigation aided vector tracking performance and the IMU error.

articleTitle: Research on Self-matching and Tuning Circuit of Transducer Based on PVDF Vibration Sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In order to ensure that the underwater acoustic communication device can output a stable signal during operation, avoid the transducer's resonance frequency drift caused by various environmental factors which can cause communication failure. This paper focuses on the transducer frequency detection technology. According to the piezoelectric effect, the vibration feedback of the transducer at different frequencies is collected by the PVDF sensor. The relationship between the frequency and the feedback signal of the sensor is obtained, and the feasibility of detecting the transducer's resonant frequency by the vibration sensor is verified. According to this characteristic, a self-check circuit of the resonant frequency is designed, which can adjust the power frequency to the optimal operating frequency and effectively improve the reliability of underwater acoustic signal transmission.

articleTitle: Self-Excited Resonance Loading Tester Design and Simulation Study
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Many key electromechanical parts and advanced electronics work in a impact-vibration compound environment. In order to better simulate the impact-vibration coupling test environment and truly reflect the performance parameters and failure mechanism, an integrated resonant cavity structure is designed. It can generate self-excited vibration loading under impact. The key component that affects the resonant signal is the properties of the resonant particles. These parameters are mainly the shape, size, and number of resonant particles. In order to study the influence of these parameters on the Self-excited resonance signal, Adams was used to simulate the impact processes. The overload curves of the impacted parts under different resonant particle properties were obtained. Studies have shown that using larger, larger numbers of cubic particles produces more obvious resonant signals. These signals have larger harmonic amplitudes and higher resonant frequencies. Thus, a set of resonant particle parameter values that can obtain a better resonant signal is designed.

articleTitle: Predictive Method of Capacitor Production Order Based on ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In the informatization process of the workshop, the company needs to have an accurate judgment and forecast on its own production capacity, the speed of order completion, and the number of forecasted orders. This paper provides a method for estimating workshop order based on ARIMA model. The main method is to differentially smooth and centralize the data, model it according to the Pandit-Wu modeling method, and use the modified recursive least square method to estimate the model parameters and calculate the AICc value of each model. After selecting the optimal model based on the AICc value, use the Q test to delete the insignificant model parameters and obtain the final model for forecasting data.

articleTitle: Economy Optimization for Series-Parallel Multi-State Systems Considering Reliability Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Multi-state systems are typical representatives in engineering system and numerous researches have been devoted to evaluate the reliability of multi-state systems. However, it is inefficient to apply the traditional algorithms to economy optimization problem for finding the optimal system structure which can balance the request of reliability and economy among several series-parallel multi-state systems, as its computational time may last for hours. Thus, this paper proposes a novel method based on ordinal optimization algorithm and Monte Carlo simulation technique to solve this economy optimization problem, instead of calculating the reliability of every system by traditional methods. Three analytically calculation methods concerning the characteristics of multi-state systems are defined, which can dramatically and effectively shorten the computational time by selecting the superior systems into reliability calculation process. A cost optimization algorithm to comprise both economic and reliability index is presented. Numerical studies and comparisons are illustrated to validate the efficiency of the proposed economy optimization method.

articleTitle: Floorplanning and Evaluation of A Hierarchical Cluster-Based NoC for Multicore System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The WK-recursive network well conforms to implementation of a large distributed system due to its many favorable properties such as regularity and recursive scalability. In this paper, we propose a hierarchical cluster-based NoC that blends WK-recursive network and Pyramid WK-recursive network, where each sub-network is optimized for different traffic types. To better exploit the communication locality of the asymmetric topology, we present a specific implementation with tile shapes and Manhattan-style wire. Using a extended cycle-accurate simulator Noxim, the experiment results show that our proposed design provides 18.6%–29.3% improvement in average network latency and 11.2%–17.8% improvement in average network throughput over the previous architecture evaluated in this study. It is demonstrated that it is feasible to implement the triangular topologies with rectangular manhattan architecture.

articleTitle: An Improved Naive Bayesian Classification Algorithm for Massive Data
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: For the low speed and accuracy in massive data classification, an improved Naive Bayesian classification algorithm for mass data processing is proposed. Firstly, feature rough clustering is carried out to cluster the features to reduce the computational complexity of feature association. Secondly, the association rules algorithm is used to mine frequent item sets of rough clustering subsets, and the generated frequent item sets are used to filter the features based on the result of classification. And then, the feature set after feature selection is weighted to improve the accuracy. Finally, the improved algorithm is implemented on the MapReduce parallelization platform and tested with five data sets of different sizes. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm in this paper could save a lot of running time when dealing with large-scale data sets, and maintain high accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Characteristics of Road Bus Service Based on Urban Rail Transit Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper discusses how to make road buses serve the urban rail transit network better. Based on the position of the both functions, grasping the convergence of passenger traffic in the both traffic modes and sections, and studying the transfer coordination and line rationality of the both, the evaluation method using grey correlation analysis focuses on parallel roads. The line rationality of bus lines was evaluated and the line of thought and method for line adjustment were proposed accordingly. Finally, the Xi'an Metro Line 2 was taken as an example to illustrate and explain it. Through the analysis of the service characteristics of the road bus under the urban rail transit environment, the road bus can serve the urban rail transit increasingly efficiently, and then the coordination of the both systems can be improved.

Author Keywords: based on urban rail transit network

articleTitle: An Improved Distributed Data Fusion Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper proposes a generalized fusion algorithm that can be used for unknown correlation probability density function in practical distributed data fusion problems.
