In a distributed sensing environment where rumors propagate due to statistical correlation of signals, the algorithm can perform data fusion with any number of probability density functions. The interoperability requirements of distributed sensing systems define that the system cannot preprocess inputs to ensure statistical independence, while the covariance intersection algorithm and fast covariance intersection algorithm are only suitable for processing independent input signals such as Gaussian signals. In the case of an unknown correlation probability density function, the fusion goal of any number of non-Gaussian inputs can be achieved by minimizing the Chernoff information of the fusion probability density function. The simulation results show that the algorithm has good fusion effect.

articleTitle: Design of Low Scale Pressure Sensor Intelligent System with Temperature Compensation Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This article designs and implements a pressure sensor intelligent system with temperature compensation, which is based on STM32F103RCT6 microcontroller. The system is used to measure accurate small range signals of pressure sensor. Designing the functional circuit makes the output of the system digitized. Utilizing the improved BP neural network algorithm compensates the digital signal of the pressure sensor to ensure the accuracy of the pressure sensor. The repeated test shows that the intelligent system compensates the temperature drift of low scale pressure sensor effectively and ensures the property and the measurement accuracy of the pressure sensor.

articleTitle: Study on Nonlinear Heat Exchanger Control System of Heat Conduction Oil of Vessel
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this paper, the differential equation of heat exchanger system is deduced according to the working principle of a vessel's heat conduction oil system. Taking the temperatures of heat conduction oil and heavy oil as the state variables, a multi-input coupled nonlinear heat exchanger model with the opening of the thyristor pressure regulating valve and heavy oil flow regulating solenoid valve as control inputs is established based on the analysis of the characteristics of the heat exchanger model. The model is decomposed into two systems: a single-input second-order linear system and a single-input nonlinear system. The sliding mode variable structure (SMVS) controller is obtained by affine nonlinear transformation of the nonlinear model. The experiments of the proportional-integral-differential (PID) and the SMVS control method based on KINGVIEW software platform are used to test the temperature of heat conduction oil and heavy oil. The results show that the SMVS control has advantages of small overshoot, fast response speed and strong anti-jamming capability.

articleTitle: A Hierarchical Time Order Petri Nets Modeling Method
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of complex system modeling by using normal Petri Nets, Hierarchical Time Order Petri Nets was put forward, and gave its definition. Taking the process of space vehicle technical preparation for example, established the Hierarchical Time Order Petri Nets, verified the model by using relational matrix. It could conclude that the order time of complex system could be exhibited strictly, the system could be grasped on the macro and micro, the verification and simulation of model would become simple.

articleTitle: Path Planning Algorithm for Mobile Robot Based on Cellular Automaton
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: We use cellular automaton to carry out a path planning algorithm for mobile robot. The environment is totally known including the starting point, the end point and the obstacles. Two different models were set based on cellular automaton. We compare both of them and choose the better one to apply in path planning. There are still some problems in avoiding collision so that we improve it by the way of increasing danger factor. The simulation results indicate that the improved path planning algorithm with cellular automaton is useful and effective for mobile robot.

articleTitle: Research of Conflicts at Signalized Intersection and Safety Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Aiming at pedestrian safety at signalized intersection, this paper investigate potential crashes between pedestrians and vehicles by applying traffic conflict techniques. First, based on the behavioral characteristics of pedestrians, and combined with the characteristics of the conflicts between pedestrians and vehicles at intersections, this paper conducted the risk degree model - SOMK. Then, this paper collects pedestrians and vehicles conflict data at sub peak period and rush hour in three signalized intersections in Weihai City based the manual video observation method. Finally, using these conflict data to calculate evaluation indicators TTC, PET, and DST and risk degree. The process of analysis of the danger of pedestrian crossing conflicts. The results show that the frequency and severity of conflicts differs according to different types and the crossing-road pedestrians' behavior also make a difference to the risk degree of different conflict types.

articleTitle: Design of A Universal Missile Automatic Test System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In order to meet the needs of the universalization of the missile automatic test system (ATS) at this stage, and to improve the mobility of the troops, a general-purpose ATS based on the PCI bus was built in this paper. A universal design was carried out in the system architecture, signal transfer, and software development. It can make full use of test resources to meet the test needs of various types of missiles. Compared with the traditional ATS, this ATS can shorten the launch preparation time, and is convenient to carry, easy to operate, high performance, and also has good scalability. Provides a reference for future research on the universalization of missile ATS.

articleTitle: Research on Rollover Prevention Stability of Heavy Truck Based on PID
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: According to the stability problem of the heavy truck, the anti-yaw moment control method based on PID is adopted, then the rollover dynamic model and the 2-DOF(two-degree-of-freedom) reference model for heavy truck are established. And a PID feedback control system is designed, it takes the deviation of the target yaw and actual yaw rate value as the control variable, and the anti-yaw moment is obtained to maintain the stability of the vehicle. Finally, the simulation model is built with matlab/simulink, the results of simulation show that the PID-based anti-yaw moment control method effectively improves the stability of heavy truck.

articleTitle: Adaptive Compensation for MISO Nonlinear Systems Against Actuator Failures
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In this note, an adaptive compensation scheme is proposed for a class of multi-input single-output (MISO) nonlinear uncertain systems with three types of common actuator failures, including stuck failure, bias failure and loss of effectiveness failure, which are uncertain in failure type, value and time. All signals are bounded and output asymptotic tracking is guaranteed with the scheme. The simulation results about an aircraft demonstrate the effectiveness of the scheme.

articleTitle: Improved Access Control Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Cloud computing security issues are increasingly serious. Behavioral trust is the trust relationship established by the entity based on its past experience of interaction. It can be either direct interaction or indirectly recommended by third parties. User behavior trust assessment using analytic hierarchy process, by collecting historical behavior information to obtain the user's behavior trust evidence, according to the characteristics of trust evidence is divided into different trust attributes which, through the analytic hierarchy process and the relative weight of each trust attribute calculated by the user Behavioral trust value. Combined with IPv6 protocol, using IPv6 extended header, the evaluation value is placed in the header for transmission and verification, making this article practical.

articleTitle: Adaptive Finite-Time Coordinated Attitude Tracking Control for Spacecraft Formation with Unknown Time-Varying Inertia
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: This paper studies the adaptive finite-time coordinated attitude tracking control problem for spacecraft formation flying under directed communication topology in presence of unknown time-varying inertia and external disturbances. First, based on robust adaptive control method, we designed two adaptive components of the controller to accommodate the uncertainties of the system and compensate the external disturbance. In addition, combined with finite-time theory, consensus algorithm and graph theory, we proposed a robust adaptive finite-time coordinated attitude tracking control law to regulate the attitude to a common time-varying reference state in finite time. And, the control law applies to more extensive systems without requiring that the topology is strongly connected digraph or connected undirected graph. Finally, simulation results illustrate the effectiveness of the presented control approach.

articleTitle: Semi-Physical Model of Drill-String System and A Speed Compensation Feedback Controller for Stick-Slip Vibrations of Drill-String
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In drilling field, the undesired stick-slip vibrations of drill-string are the main reason for the failure of the drilling system. In order to simulate the stick-slip vibrations phenomenon of the drill-string, a semi-physical device including actual top drive is applied in this paper. To suppress the stick-slip vibrations existing in the drill-string system, a speed compensation feedback controller is proposed. The proposed controller is tested in the semi-physical device. Finally, the semi-physical device completes the hardware-in-the-loop simulation of the stick-slip vibrations of the drill-string. And, the performance of the speed compensation feedback controller is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Design of Routing Gateway for Smart Home Based on Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: In order to reduce the cost and establish the wireless network for smart home system, and realize the integration of router and smart home control gateway, this paper proposes a low-cost design of routing gateway for smart home. With Openwrt open source routing system and Luci WEB framework, using WiFi and Zigbee as the main communication network, we design the frame structure of communication data and developed control interface for smart home, to meet the users' needs of surfing the Internet and the control of the equipment and check the room information of the family. The experimental results show that users can control home wireless devices and view room information through webpage, and realize the integration of various wireless communication modes and the establishment of wireless network for smart home system. The design of this paper has a certain practical significance for the existing smart home industry.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Fault Diagnosis of Seed Source Assembly Device Based on Expert System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The building of fault diagnosis expert system of seed source assembly device was on the basis of the characteristics of seed source automatic assembly device. In order to improve equipment efficiency and reduce the effect of radiation on staff, the fault diagnosis expert system realized the remote intelligent of fault diagnosis, put forward integrate expert system with fault tree technique and established fault tree model represented by the common faults of seed source assembly device. So it generated expert system knowledge base and realized fault diagnosis reasoning mechanism, the combination of the knowledge base and the reasoning mechanism overcame the difficulty of obtaining knowledge of traditional fault diagnosis expert system and improved the efficiency of fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Theoretical Study on the Influence of the Backing Material of A PVDF Pyroelectric Sensor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: PVDF pyroelectric sensor was widely used in many fields. At present, the PVDF pyroelectric sensor has been applied for acoustic measurement. However, the effect of backing on the sensitivity of sensor was not particularly studied until now. In this paper, a Physical model was established in the finite element software. According to this model, the waveform of pyroelectric signal was predicted. By changing the parameters of the backing material, the influence of the backing on the sensitivity of the sensor was analyzed. It is confirmed that the Physical model is effective and the constant pressure heat capacity, attenuation coefficient and acoustic impedance of backing material directly affect the sensitivity of the sensor.

articleTitle: Optimization of Path Blocking of Dangerous Counterexample Based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: How to block the occurrence of the dangerous counterexample path in a complex system becomes critical, and it is necessary to design the safety of path that blocks the occurrence of the accident. At present, there are few studies on such problems at home and abroad. This study investigates the accident cases that have occurred and proposes a method that can effectively block the occurrence of counterexamples. The feasibility of the blocking method has been proven through a practical example.

articleTitle: Research on the Operation Plan of Express Freight Train Based on Satisfaction of Shipper time
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: It is a new trend in the freight delivery industry to develop express freight transportation. Operation plan is both the basis of transportation organization and the important way to realize the satisfaction of shipper time. This paper fully considers the shipper's requirements on time value, establishes a model to design the express freight train operation plan which maximizes the satisfaction of shipper on delivered time and minimizes the operation cost of railway enterprise, and validates the feasibility by a case study. The results show that the model is a meaningful exploration in the field of express freight train operation planning.

articleTitle: Servo Driver Inverter Circuit Based on Pure Resistance Current Sampling
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The current sampling method is the key to determine the performance of the servo driver, and widening the current loop bandwidth is one of the main ways to improve the dynamic performance of the driver. This paper proposes a scheme based on purely resistive sampling of the output phase current of the servo driver. That is, the two-phase current of PMSM is sampled by pure resistance, and the phase current analog signal is analog-digital converted by TI's AMC1204. The phase current is analog filtering and digital filtering to improve the sampling effect of the phase current. Finally, the experimental results show that the designed servo driver current loop bandwidth frequency reaches 1.8kHz, which is much higher than the Hall current sensor scheme (current loop bandwidth frequency is 1.2kHz), which greatly improves the dynamic performance of the servo system.

articleTitle: Optimization Design of Serial-Parallel Coupled Micro-Perforated Panel Absorbers by Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: It is found that a new type of serial-parallel coupled micro-perforated panel absorbers (SPMPA) possess a good sound absorption performance. However, compared with traditional single layer MPP absorbers, such type of MPP absorbers have more complicated construction and involve more structure parameters, which therefore make the design of SPMPA more difficult and complicated. To solve this problem, an optimization design of SPMPA is proposed and studied. Firstly, based on the mathematical model of SPMPA, genetic algorithm (GA) is used in this study as a tool to solve the optimization problem of finding the best combination of the structure parameters of SPMPA providing the maximum average absorption within a prescribed frequency band and given variation ranges of their constitutive parameters. Results show that GA provides a quick and effective method in designing SPMPA.

articleTitle: Research on Cueing Search Strategy of Active and Passive Sensors
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: The active and passive sensors are widely applied in military field now, although having both advantages and disadvantages, they can compensate each other. The paper have researched on cueing search strategy of AESA (Active Electronic Scanning Array) and ESM(Electric Support Measure). Firstly, a kind of method to calculate the success probability of ESM Cueing AESA to search is provided. Secondly, the paper have analyzed the relationship between aspect angle and beam residence time. Thirdly, according to the dynamic update probability model and based on the idea that radar should detect where targets are more probable to exist more, a new search strategy is provided. Finally, based on the results of one thousand simulations, through comparing the probability of the target being captured by radar and the average number of beam positions have been detected with the traditional strategy, it can be concluded that the strategy provided by the paper is more effective to capture the target and the less time is needed.

articleTitle: A Survey on Route Planning Methods of AUV Considering Influence of Ocean Current
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: When AUV travel in the ocean, it will unavoidably be affected by the current. Different from the ground and air environment, the influence of ocean current on AUV route planning is much greater than that of wind to ground robot and air UAV path planning. Firstly, we describe the research status of intelligent optimization algorithm combined with ocean current in the field of AUV route planning and optimization in detail and analyze the planning performance and adaptive scenario of different algorithms in the flow environment. Secondly, the application of classical optimization and planning algorithm under the influence of ocean current in AUV route planning is reviewed. The analysis shows that the A* algorithm and the level set algorithm combined with the ocean current get more attraction. Thirdly, the difference between the path planning of the robot and route planning of the AUV is compared and the total research distribution of the AUV route planning algorithm considering the influence of the sea current after 2000 is given. Finally, we propose that the extension research based on A* algorithm and level set method should be the future development of AUV route planning in the real ocean environment.

articleTitle: In-flight Longitudinal Guidance for RLV in TAEM Phase
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: A longitudinal predictor-corrector guidance algorithm based on online generated dynamic pressure profile without integral deduction and aerodynamic identification is researched for reusable launch vehicle in terminal area energy management phase. The algorithm predicts the range-to-go of the vehicle through the current energy state and the dynamic pressure profile parameter by inquiring the off-line calculated data table, the error of the range-to-go caused by the model deviation is considered in-fight based on the measured flight status information. Ground track range is calculated by ground track parameters. The dynamic pressure profile parameter is updated online due to the error between ground track range and range-to-go, which enables the vehicle to arrive at the approach and landing interface with high precision. The simulation results show that the method improves the efficiency of online trajectory prediction, insensitive to the dispersal of the initial position, and has strong adaptability to model deviation.

articleTitle: A Self-adaptive Cascade Fuzzy PID Method of Attitude Control for Quadrotor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Quadrotor is a popular type of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). Usually, it can be regarded as a complex nonlinear control system, characterized of being multi-variable, under-actuated and strong-coupling. It, nowadays, has raised great interests of researchers due to several challenges, for instance it is time consuming to tune and adjust key parameters of a controller, also the attitude of a UAV would be too sensitive to environmental factors. The work proposes a new cascade fuzzy proportional integral derivative (PID) method for quadrotor. The method is based on the theory of fuzzy mathematics and control system modelling. One of the advantages of our method is that key control parameters are self-adapted to the PID controller designed. To verify the performance of the new method, we numerically simulate and quantitatively compare it with the conventional single-stack PID algorithm and cascade PID algorithm, with two indicators of responding speed and anti-interference ability of the control system. The results suggested that the method outperforms the rivals in terms of the indicators measured.

articleTitle: Evacuation Entropy Particle Swarms Optimization (E-PSO) Evacuation Model Considering Panic Factors
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: As the existing crowd evacuation model seldom considers the influence of crowd confusion degree on the evacuation results. This paper proposes evacuation entropy particle swarms optimization (E-PSO) crowd evacuation model. This model considers the impact of obstacles and the surrounding people on evacuees' evacuation behavior in the evacuation process. And the concept of evacuation entropy is introduced to quantitatively describe the degree of chaos in crowd movement and is used to correct the individual speed direction in the model. The model further considers the influence of individual panic psychology and the presence of leaders in evacuation. The simulation results show that the panic of evacuees will aggravate the degree of chaos on the event, but the addition of leaders will reduce the degree of confusion and improve the evacuation efficiency. At the same time, compared with the traditional PSO model, the modified PSO model with evacuation entropy can reduce the degree of confusion on the evacuation process, effectively avoid the occurrence of crowded stampede accident and improve the evacuation efficiency.

articleTitle: Hybrid Active-Passive α-stability Fault-Tolerant Control Research of Nonlinear NCS under DETCS
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE 4th International Conference on Control Science and Systems Engineering (ICCSSE)
abstract: Aimed at the nominal nonlinear NCS, the design of hybrid active-passive α - stability fault-tolerant controller under DETCS is investigated. Considering the event-triggered condition, network induced delay and actuator fault with failure, a nonlinear NCS model is established. And passive α - stability fault-tolerant controller was designed to ensure the system α - stability when a fault in the set occurred and slow down the rate of performance deterioration when a fault out the set happened. The fault information is detected by fault detection observer. Once the accurate fault information is obtained, the active compensation is taken immediately. The correctness and effectiveness of the results are verified by a simulation example.

Author Keywords: hybrid active-passive α - stability fault-tolerant control
